_comment: EXT-63, arm 23 — the 1 h SETTLED-WINDOW grading of the full stack:
canonical single-layer EXT-CB + LV-1 (seed frame) + LV-2 (carry de-mean) + LV-4
(frame-invariant carry screen) + LV-5 (within-epoch mu).
Read against arm 19 (LV-1+2, settled sd 4.98) and arm 21 (+LV-4, settled sd 15.53).
WHAT IS BEING GRADED.  LV-4 removed a screen that had been withholding ~74 % of the
carry priors on a frame artifact; admitting them exposed that LV-2's mu was applied
LAG-1, whose loop gain scales with the folded fraction -- the level limit-cycled
(~3-epoch period, range 54 TECU).  LV-5 removes the lag: mu is reduced serially
between PASS A and PASS B and folded against the SAME epoch.  The arm-22 smoke
showed the cycle damped (20-ep sd 13.06 -> 5.99) with the residual common mode
measured at mean |resid| 0.0057 m against max |mu| 8.50 m -- i.e. the correction
nulls the frame force to ~0.07 % of its size.  1 h is where that has to hold.
PREDICTION, STATED BEFORE THE RUN:
- Settled (20-60 min) sd BELOW arm 19's 4.98 TECU, and far below arm 21's 15.53.
If sd lands between them, the lag was only part of the loop and the next suspect
is the carry variance itself (q=1e-9 with var ~1e-2 m^2 is a very stiff prior to
admit at 97 % once nothing screens it).
- Fold fraction ~97 % (arm 21's), erases order 100 over 121 epochs, 0 stand-downs.
- mean |resid| stays ~1e-2 m or below.  A residual that GROWS with the window is
the candidate-vs-folded set divergence, and the honest fix is a two-pass PASS B.
- a00: settled mean within a few TECU of GIM 32.24.  Arm 22's 20-ep settle was ~38
(high), so a drift DOWN toward 32 over the hour is the expected shape; a level
that parks at 38-40 means the admitted carry is re-importing a level offset that
the de-mean does not see -- report it rather than tuning k.
